-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.PbWireRaft` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem map_ofNat_toNat (xs : List w64) : List.map (BitVec.ofNat 64) (List.map (fun x =>
    BitVec.toNat x) xs) = xs

theorem lastVarint_fvals (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (n : Nat) : Wire.lastVarint ks n =
    (List.filterMap FVal.asVarint (fvals ks n)).getLast?

theorem boolVarint_lt (b : Bool) : boolVarint b < 2 ^ 64

def fvals (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (n : Nat) : List Wire.FVal :=
  List.filterMap (fun p => if p.fst = n then some p.snd else none) ks

def snapRecs (data md : Option (List w8)) : List (Nat × Wire.FVal) :=
  Wire.optF 1 Wire.FVal.len data ++ Wire.optF 2 Wire.FVal.len md

def metaDecodeD (d : Nat) (parts : List (List w8)) : Option MetaDec :=
  if parts = [] then some metaDecZero
  else
    if d = 0 then none
    else
      match Wire.decodeMerged metaSchema parts with
      | none => none
      | some (ks, snd) =>
        Option.map
          (fun cs =>
            { cs := cs, index := BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 2).getD 0),
              term := BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 3).getD 0) })
          (csDecodeD (d - 1) (Wire.allLen ks 1))

theorem flatten_singletons (xs : List w64) : (List.map (fun v => [BitVec.toNat v]) xs).flatten =
    List.map (fun x => BitVec.toNat x) xs

def repVarint (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (num : Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  Option.map List.flatten
    (List.mapM
      (fun v =>
        match v with
        | Wire.FVal.varint n => some [n]
        | Wire.FVal.len bs => packedVarints (bs.length + 1) bs
        | x => some [])
      (List.filterMap (fun p => if p.fst = num then some p.snd else none) ks))

def boolVarint (b : Bool) : Nat :=
  if b = true then 1 else 0

theorem repVarint_fvals (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (n : Nat) : repVarint ks n = Option.map
    List.flatten (List.mapM (fun v => match v with | Wire.FVal.varint n => some [n] | Wire.FVal.len
    bs => packedVarints (bs.length + 1) bs | x => some []) (fvals ks n))

def msgRecs (type : Option w32) (to frm term logTerm index : Option w64) (ents : List (List w8))
    (commit : Option w64) (snap : Option (List w8)) (reject : Option Bool) (rejectHint : Option w64)
    (ctx : Option (List w8)) (vote : Option w64) (resps : List (List w8)) : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)
    :=
  Wire.optF 1 (fun t => Wire.FVal.varint (enumVarint t)) type ++
                            Wire.optF 2 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) to ++
                          Wire.optF 3 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) frm ++
                        Wire.optF 4 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) term ++
                      Wire.optF 5 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) logTerm ++
                    Wire.optF 6 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) index ++
                  List.map (fun e => (7, Wire.FVal.len e)) ents ++
                Wire.optF 8 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) commit ++
              Wire.optF 9 Wire.FVal.len snap ++
            Wire.optF 10 (fun b => Wire.FVal.varint (boolVarint b)) reject ++
          Wire.optF 11 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) rejectHint ++
        Wire.optF 12 Wire.FVal.len ctx ++
      Wire.optF 13 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) vote ++
    List.map (fun r => (14, Wire.FVal.len r)) resps

theorem lastLen_fvals (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (n : Nat) : Wire.lastLen ks n = (List.filterMap
    FVal.asLen (fvals ks n)).getLast?

def (sealed) instReprMetaDec.repr : MetaDec → Nat → Std.Format

def snapDecodeD (d : Nat) (parts : List (List w8)) : Option (Option SnapDec) :=
  if parts = [] then some none
  else
    if d = 0 then none
    else
      match Wire.decodeMerged snapSchema parts with
      | none => none
      | some (ks, snd) =>
        Option.map (fun m => some { data := (Wire.lastLen ks 1).getD [], md := m })
          (metaDecodeD (d - 1) (Wire.allLen ks 2))

theorem cc2DecodeRaw_nil : cc2DecodeRaw [] = some (0, [], [])

theorem snapRecs_ok (data md : Option (List w8)) (hd : ∀ (b : List w8), data = some b → b.length < 2
    ^ 64) (hm : ∀ (b : List w8), md = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (p : Nat × Wire.FVal) : p ∈
    snapRecs data md → Wire.RecOk snapSchema p

structure MsgDec : Type where
  type : w32
  to : w64
  frm : w64
  term : w64
  logTerm : w64
  index : w64
  ents : List (w64 × w64 × w32 × List w8)
  commit : w64
  snap : Option SnapDec
  reject : Bool
  rejectHint : w64
  ctx : List w8
  vote : w64
  nresps : Nat

theorem boolVarint_ne (b : Bool) : (boolVarint b != 0) = b

def csDecZero : CSDec :=
  { voters := [], learners := [], votersOutgoing := [], learnersNext := [], autoLeave := false }

structure MetaDec : Type where
  cs : CSDec
  index : w64
  term : w64

def instDecidableEqMetaDec : DecidableEq MetaDec :=
  instDecidableEqMetaDec.decEq

structure CSDec : Type where
  voters : List w64
  learners : List w64
  votersOutgoing : List w64
  learnersNext : List w64
  autoLeave : Bool

def repW64 (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (num : Nat) : Option (List w64) :=
  Option.map (fun x => List.map (BitVec.ofNat 64) x) (repVarint ks num)

theorem snapDecodeD_enc (d : Nat) (hd0 : d ≠ 0) (data md : Option (List w8)) (uf : List w8) (hu :
    ufWire snapSchema uf) (hd : ∀ (b : List w8), data = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (hm : ∀ (b :
    List w8), md = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (m : MetaDec) (hmd : metaDecodeD (d - 1) md.toList =
    some m) : snapDecodeD d [snapEncRaw data md uf] = some (some { data := data.getD [], md := m })

theorem filterMap_asLen_map (xs : List (List w8)) : List.filterMap FVal.asLen (List.map
    Wire.FVal.len xs) = xs

def enumVarint (t : w32) : Nat :=
  (BitVec.ofInt 64 (BitVec.toInt t)).toNat

def instDecidableEqSnapDec : DecidableEq SnapDec :=
  instDecidableEqSnapDec.decEq

theorem fvals_nil (n : Nat) : fvals [] n = []

def csEncRaw (voters learners votersOutgoing learnersNext : List w64) (autoLeave : Option Bool) (uf
    : List w8) : List w8 :=
  Wire.encode (csRecs voters learners votersOutgoing learnersNext autoLeave) uf

theorem entryRecs_length (type : Option w32) (term index : Option w64) (data : Option (List w8)) :
    (Wire.encFields (entryRecs type term index data)).length = (((match type with | none => 0 | some
    t => 1 + varintSize (enumVarint t)) + match term with | none => 0 | some v => 1 + varintSize
    (BitVec.toNat v)) + match index with | none => 0 | some v => 1 + varintSize (BitVec.toNat v)) +
    match data with | none => 0 | some bs => 1 + varintSize bs.length + bs.length

def msgDecodeRaw (bs : List w8) : Option MsgDec :=
  msgDecodeD 10000 bs

theorem ofNat_lastVarint_opt (o : Option w64) : BitVec.ofNat 64 ((List.filterMap FVal.asVarint
    (Option.map (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) o).toList).getLast?.getD 0) = o.getD 0

theorem enumVarint_lt (t : w32) : enumVarint t < 2 ^ 64

def ccsDecodeRaw (bs : List w8) : Option (w32 × w64) :=
  Option.map
    (fun p => (BitVec.ofNat 32 ((Wire.lastVarint p.fst 1).getD 0), BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint p.fst 2).getD 0)))
    (Wire.decode ccsSchema bs)

def csDecodeD (d : Nat) (parts : List (List w8)) : Option CSDec :=
  if parts = [] then some csDecZero
  else
    if d = 0 then none
    else
      match Wire.decodeMerged csSchema parts with
      | none => none
      | some (ks, snd) =>
        match repW64 ks 1, repW64 ks 2, repW64 ks 3, repW64 ks 4 with
        | some v, some l, some vo, some ln =>
          some { voters := v, learners := l, votersOutgoing := vo, learnersNext := ln, autoLeave := lastBool ks 5 }
        | x, x_1, x_2, x_3 => none

def instDecidableEqMsgDec.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : MsgDec) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  |
  { type := a, to := a_1, frm := a_2, term := a_3, logTerm := a_4, index := a_5, ents := a_6, commit := a_7, snap := a_8,
      reject := a_9, rejectHint := a_10, ctx := a_11, vote := a_12, nresps := a_13 },
    { type := b, to := b_1, frm := b_2, term := b_3, logTerm := b_4, index := b_5, ents := b_6, commit := b_7,
      snap := b_8, reject := b_9, rejectHint := b_10, ctx := b_11, vote := b_12, nresps := b_13 } =>
    if h : a = b then
      h ▸
        if h : a_1 = b_1 then
          h ▸
            if h : a_2 = b_2 then
              h ▸
                if h : a_3 = b_3 then
                  h ▸
                    if h : a_4 = b_4 then
                      h ▸
                        if h : a_5 = b_5 then
                          h ▸
                            if h : a_6 = b_6 then
                              h ▸
                                if h : a_7 = b_7 then
                                  h ▸
                                    if h : a_8 = b_8 then
                                      h ▸
                                        if h : a_9 = b_9 then
                                          h ▸
                                            if h : a_10 = b_10 then
                                              h ▸
                                                if h : a_11 = b_11 then
                                                  h ▸
                                                    if h : a_12 = b_12 then
                                                      h ▸ if h : a_13 = b_13 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
                                                    else isFalse ⋯
                                                else isFalse ⋯
                                            else isFalse ⋯
                                        else isFalse ⋯
                                    else isFalse ⋯
                                else isFalse ⋯
                            else isFalse ⋯
                        else isFalse ⋯
                    else isFalse ⋯
                else isFalse ⋯
            else isFalse ⋯
        else isFalse ⋯
    else isFalse ⋯

theorem fvals_optF {α : Type} (o : Option α) (m n : Nat) (f : α → Wire.FVal) : fvals (Wire.optF m f
    o) n = if m = n then (Option.map f o).toList else []

def (sealed) instReprMsgDec.repr : MsgDec → Nat → Std.Format

theorem fvals_map {α : Type} (xs : List α) (m n : Nat) (f : α → Wire.FVal) : fvals (List.map (fun x
    => (m, f x)) xs) n = if m = n then List.map f xs else []

theorem allLen_fvals (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (n : Nat) : Wire.allLen ks n = List.filterMap
    FVal.asLen (fvals ks n)

def instReprMsgDec : Repr MsgDec :=
  { reprPrec := instReprMsgDec.repr }

def metaEncRaw (cs : Option (List w8)) (index term : Option w64) (uf : List w8) : List w8 :=
  Wire.encode (metaRecs cs index term) uf

def FVal.asVarint : Wire.FVal → Option Nat :=
  match x✝ with
  | Wire.FVal.varint n => some n
  | x => none

def (sealed) instReprSnapDec.repr : SnapDec → Nat → Std.Format

theorem entDecodeRaw_enc (type : Option w32) (term index : Option w64) (data : Option (List w8)) (uf
    : List w8) (hu : ufWire entrySchema uf) (hd : ∀ (d : List w8), data = some d → d.length < 2 ^
    64) : entDecodeRaw (entryEncRaw type term index data uf) = some (term.getD 0, index.getD 0,
    type.getD 0, data.getD [])

def instDecidableEqCSDec : DecidableEq CSDec :=
  instDecidableEqCSDec.decEq

theorem packedVarints.eq_def (x✝ : Nat) (x✝¹ : List w8) : packedVarints x✝ x✝¹ = match x✝, x✝¹ with
    | 0, x => none | fuel.succ, bs => if bs = [] then some [] else match Wire.readVarint bs with |
    none => none | some (v, r) => Option.map (fun x => v :: x) (packedVarints fuel r)

theorem msgDecodeD.eq_def (x✝ : Nat) (x✝¹ : List w8) : msgDecodeD x✝ x✝¹ = match x✝, x✝¹ with | 0, x
    => none | d.succ, bs => match Wire.decode msgSchema bs with | none => none | some (ks, snd) =>
    match List.mapM (entDecodeD d) (Wire.allLen ks 7), snapDecodeD d (Wire.allLen ks 9), List.mapM
    (msgDecodeD d) (Wire.allLen ks 14) with | some ents, some snap, some rs => some { type :=
    BitVec.ofNat 32 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 1).getD 0), to := BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks
    2).getD 0), frm := BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 3).getD 0), term := BitVec.ofNat 64
    ((Wire.lastVarint ks 4).getD 0), logTerm := BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 5).getD 0),
    index := BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 6).getD 0), ents := ents, commit := BitVec.ofNat
    64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 8).getD 0), snap := snap, reject := lastBool ks 10, rejectHint :=
    BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 11).getD 0), ctx := (Wire.lastLen ks 12).getD [], vote :=
    BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint ks 13).getD 0), nresps := rs.length } | x, x_1, x_2 => none

def entryRecs (type : Option w32) (term index : Option w64) (data : Option (List w8)) : List (Nat ×
    Wire.FVal) :=
  Wire.optF 1 (fun t => Wire.FVal.varint (enumVarint t)) type ++
        Wire.optF 2 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) term ++
      Wire.optF 3 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) index ++
    Wire.optF 4 Wire.FVal.len data

def instDecidableEqCSDec.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : CSDec) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { voters := a, learners := a_1, votersOutgoing := a_2, learnersNext := a_3, autoLeave := a_4 },
    { voters := b, learners := b_1, votersOutgoing := b_2, learnersNext := b_3, autoLeave := b_4 } =>
    if h : a = b then
      h ▸
        if h : a_1 = b_1 then
          h ▸
            if h : a_2 = b_2 then
              h ▸ if h : a_3 = b_3 then h ▸ if h : a_4 = b_4 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
            else isFalse ⋯
        else isFalse ⋯
    else isFalse ⋯

def instDecidableEqMetaDec.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : MetaDec) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { cs := a, index := a_1, term := a_2 }, { cs := b, index := b_1, term := b_2 } =>
    if h : a = b then h ▸ if h : a_1 = b_1 then h ▸ if h : a_2 = b_2 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
    else isFalse ⋯

def cc2DecodeRaw (bs : List w8) : Option (w32 × List (w32 × w64) × List w8) :=
  match Wire.decode cc2Schema bs with
  | none => none
  | some p =>
    match List.mapM ccsDecodeRaw (Wire.allLen p.fst 2) with
    | none => none
    | some chs => some (BitVec.ofNat 32 ((Wire.lastVarint p.fst 1).getD 0), chs, (Wire.lastLen p.fst 3).getD [])

theorem mapM_unpacked (xs : List w64) : List.mapM (fun v => match v with | Wire.FVal.varint n =>
    some [n] | Wire.FVal.len bs => packedVarints (bs.length + 1) bs | x => some []) (List.map (fun v
    => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) xs) = some (List.map (fun v => [BitVec.toNat v]) xs)

def packedVarints : Nat → List w8 → Option (List Nat) :=
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => List w8 → Option (List Nat)) x✝¹ packedVarints._f x✝

def FVal.asLen : Wire.FVal → Option (List w8) :=
  match x✝ with
  | Wire.FVal.len b => some b
  | x => none

theorem csDecodeD_enc (d : Nat) (hd : d ≠ 0) (v l vo ln : List w64) (al : Option Bool) (uf : List
    w8) (hu : ufWire csSchema uf) : csDecodeD d [csEncRaw v l vo ln al uf] = some { voters := v,
    learners := l, votersOutgoing := vo, learnersNext := ln, autoLeave := al.getD false }

theorem csRecs_ok (v l vo ln : List w64) (al : Option Bool) (p : Nat × Wire.FVal) : p ∈ csRecs v l
    vo ln al → Wire.RecOk csSchema p

theorem msgRecs_ok (type : Option w32) (to frm term logTerm index : Option w64) (ents : List (List
    w8)) (commit : Option w64) (snap : Option (List w8)) (reject : Option Bool) (rejectHint : Option
    w64) (ctx : Option (List w8)) (vote : Option w64) (resps : List (List w8)) (he : ∀ (b : List
    w8), b ∈ ents → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (hs : ∀ (b : List w8), snap = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (hc
    : ∀ (b : List w8), ctx = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (hr : ∀ (b : List w8), b ∈ resps → b.length
    < 2 ^ 64) (p : Nat × Wire.FVal) : p ∈ msgRecs type to frm term logTerm index ents commit snap
    reject rejectHint ctx vote resps → Wire.RecOk msgSchema p

theorem packedVarints_nil (f : Nat) : packedVarints (f + 1) [] = some []

theorem fvals_append (a b : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (n : Nat) : fvals (a ++ b) n = fvals a n ++
    fvals b n

def (sealed) instReprCSDec.repr : CSDec → Nat → Std.Format

theorem ofNat_enumVarint (t : w32) : BitVec.ofNat 32 (enumVarint t) = t

def entryEncRaw (type : Option w32) (term index : Option w64) (data : Option (List w8)) (uf : List
    w8) : List w8 :=
  Wire.encode (entryRecs type term index data) uf

theorem metaRecs_ok (cs : Option (List w8)) (index term : Option w64) (hc : ∀ (b : List w8), cs =
    some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (p : Nat × Wire.FVal) : p ∈ metaRecs cs index term → Wire.RecOk
    metaSchema p

def metaRecs (cs : Option (List w8)) (index term : Option w64) : List (Nat × Wire.FVal) :=
  Wire.optF 1 Wire.FVal.len cs ++ Wire.optF 2 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) index ++
    Wire.optF 3 (fun v => Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v)) term

def csRecs (voters learners votersOutgoing learnersNext : List w64) (autoLeave : Option Bool) : List
    (Nat × Wire.FVal) :=
  List.map (fun v => (1, Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v))) voters ++
          List.map (fun v => (2, Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v))) learners ++
        List.map (fun v => (3, Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v))) votersOutgoing ++
      List.map (fun v => (4, Wire.FVal.varint (BitVec.toNat v))) learnersNext ++
    Wire.optF 5 (fun b => Wire.FVal.varint (boolVarint b)) autoLeave

def lastBool (ks : List (Nat × Wire.FVal)) (num : Nat) : Bool :=
  (Wire.lastVarint ks num).getD 0 != 0

structure SnapDec : Type where
  data : List w8
  md : MetaDec

def msgDecodeD : Nat → List w8 → Option MsgDec :=
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => List w8 → Option MsgDec) x✝¹ msgDecodeD._f x✝

def snapEncRaw (data md : Option (List w8)) (uf : List w8) : List w8 :=
  Wire.encode (snapRecs data md) uf

def instReprSnapDec : Repr SnapDec :=
  { reprPrec := instReprSnapDec.repr }

theorem msgDecodeD_enc (d : Nat) (type : Option w32) (to frm term logTerm index : Option w64) (ents
    : List (List w8)) (commit : Option w64) (snap : Option (List w8)) (reject : Option Bool)
    (rejectHint : Option w64) (ctx : Option (List w8)) (vote : Option w64) (resps : List (List w8))
    (uf : List w8) (hu : ufWire msgSchema uf) (he : ∀ (b : List w8), b ∈ ents → b.length < 2 ^ 64)
    (hs : ∀ (b : List w8), snap = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (hc : ∀ (b : List w8), ctx = some b →
    b.length < 2 ^ 64) (hr : ∀ (b : List w8), b ∈ resps → b.length < 2 ^ 64) (es : List (w64 × w64 ×
    w32 × List w8)) (hes : List.mapM (entDecodeD d) ents = some es) (sn : Option SnapDec) (hsn :
    snapDecodeD d snap.toList = some sn) (rs : List MsgDec) (hrs : List.mapM (msgDecodeD d) resps =
    some rs) : msgDecodeD (d + 1) (msgEncRaw type to frm term logTerm index ents commit snap reject
    rejectHint ctx vote resps uf) = some { type := type.getD 0, to := to.getD 0, frm := frm.getD 0,
    term := term.getD 0, logTerm := logTerm.getD 0, index := index.getD 0, ents := es, commit :=
    commit.getD 0, snap := sn, reject := reject.getD false, rejectHint := rejectHint.getD 0, ctx :=
    ctx.getD [], vote := vote.getD 0, nresps := rs.length }

def instReprCSDec : Repr CSDec :=
  { reprPrec := instReprCSDec.repr }

theorem metaDecodeD_enc (d : Nat) (hd : d ≠ 0) (cs : Option (List w8)) (index term : Option w64) (uf
    : List w8) (hu : ufWire metaSchema uf) (hc : ∀ (b : List w8), cs = some b → b.length < 2 ^ 64)
    (csd : CSDec) (hcs : csDecodeD (d - 1) cs.toList = some csd) : metaDecodeD d [metaEncRaw cs
    index term uf] = some { cs := csd, index := index.getD 0, term := term.getD 0 }

def entDecodeD (d : Nat) (bs : List w8) : Option (w64 × w64 × w32 × List w8) :=
  if d = 0 then none else entDecodeRaw bs

def metaDecZero : MetaDec :=
  { cs := csDecZero, index := 0, term := 0 }

def msgEncRaw (type : Option w32) (to frm term logTerm index : Option w64) (ents : List (List w8))
    (commit : Option w64) (snap : Option (List w8)) (reject : Option Bool) (rejectHint : Option w64)
    (ctx : Option (List w8)) (vote : Option w64) (resps : List (List w8)) (uf : List w8) : List w8
    :=
  Wire.encode (msgRecs type to frm term logTerm index ents commit snap reject rejectHint ctx vote resps) uf

def instDecidableEqSnapDec.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : SnapDec) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { data := a, md := a_1 }, { data := b, md := b_1 } =>
    if h : a = b then h ▸ if h : a_1 = b_1 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯

def instReprMetaDec : Repr MetaDec :=
  { reprPrec := instReprMetaDec.repr }

theorem entryRecs_ok (type : Option w32) (term index : Option w64) (data : Option (List w8)) (hd : ∀
    (d : List w8), data = some d → d.length < 2 ^ 64) (p : Nat × Wire.FVal) : p ∈ entryRecs type
    term index data → Wire.RecOk entrySchema p

def entDecodeRaw (bs : List w8) : Option (w64 × w64 × w32 × List w8) :=
  Option.map
    (fun p =>
      (BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint p.fst 2).getD 0), BitVec.ofNat 64 ((Wire.lastVarint p.fst 3).getD 0),
        BitVec.ofNat 32 ((Wire.lastVarint p.fst 1).getD 0), (Wire.lastLen p.fst 4).getD []))
    (Wire.decode entrySchema bs)

def instDecidableEqMsgDec : DecidableEq MsgDec :=
  instDecidableEqMsgDec.decEq
